headlines: Iliana Brookfoot returned from Hollow Wood with a story she could only tell in pieces.
Word from the road south: the safety the constable promised does not extend past Bell Ridge.
Three rumors in one evening. They contradicted each other; the room enjoyed all three.
footnotes: The pickled river-onion has gone, and good riddance.
Pellan the Lame won a bet against Hoke the Tinker over the number of moons currently visible.
A song no one quite caught, sung by someone who did not stay for the second verse.
